description: Metadata, dependency relationships, load priority, and update keys for a QuarterMaster mod.

description.description: Summary description of the mod's features.

game_version.description: Supported Mud and Blood version range (e.g. '>=0.5.3').

id.description: Unique lowercase identifier for the mod (e.g. 'gcore', 'tactical_overhaul').

load_priority.description: Ascending load priority: lower numbers execute FIRST (e.g. 5 = Core Framework, 50 = Gameplay, 90 = Dev/Tools).

min_qm.description: Oldest QuarterMaster this mod runs on: a version ('1.2.0' means that version or newer) or a range ('>=1.2 <2'). An older QuarterMaster skips the mod.

name.description: Human-readable display name of the mod.

overrides.description: Launcher check findings the author checked and silences, as '<check>:<name>' or '<check>:*', e.g. 'redefined_global:loadModSettings'. Not the qm.toml overrides. See the modding wiki, Part 7: https://gamiseus.github.io/wiki/

qm_features.description: QuarterMaster features this mod needs, e.g. 'overrides' or 'anchors'. A QuarterMaster without one of them skips the mod.

requires.description: Hard dependencies mapped to version ranges (e.g. {'gcore': '>=1.0.0'}).

save_content.description: What this mod adds that a save can hold, so the save still loads when the mod is off. See the modding wiki, Part 1, Saves and your mod: https://gamiseus.github.io/wiki/

weapons.description: The mod's weapon tag -> the game weapon (its tag, e.g. 'k98') a saved one becomes while the mod is off.

title: QuarterMaster Mod Manifest (mod.json v1)
